item.title: Serenity Forge Emotional Impact Bundle
item.content:encoded:
Get in touch with your sensitive side with this bundle of games from Serenity Forge! These emotional journeys will lead you through layered family dramas and post-apocalyptic deserts where humanity is the only thing we have left. Travel through a wasteland full of mutants in search of family in LISA: the Painful and LISA: The Joyful! Discover what immortality truly costs in the eerie RPG Death’s Gambit: Afterlife! Search through your childhood house to find your missing family in Gone Home! Exciting adventures and moving storytelling await in this bundle of the best from Serenity Forge. Grab them all now at the price of your choosing, and support Children’s Miracle Network Hospitals with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 6th, 2027.

item.title: Double Fine Publisher Bundle
item.content:encoded:
Get the best of Double Fine in this bundle of the video game publisher’s greatest hits! Embrace your psychic powers and battle inside the minds of your enemies in Psychonauts! Explore a fantasy world with a heavy metal twist and save the universe with the power of rock in Brütal Legend! Take control of your fate with two teenagers from fantastically different worlds in the gorgeously hand-animated Broken Age! Explore all of these games and more in this bundle from Double Fine! You choose what you pay, and support Double Fine’s indie game making charity Day of the Devs with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 6th, 2027.

item.title: The Factory Must Grow
item.content:encoded:
The factories are open for business. This construction-focused bundle offers builder-style games with a wide range of flavors, ranging from complex space expeditions to cozy, relaxing island sims. Strap on your helmet for Eden Crafters, the ultimate open-world survival, crafting, and factory-building game where you transform far-off planets into close-knit communities; terraform a dying planet back to health in Blossom: The Seed of Life; or try Oddsparks for a unique blend of automation and real-time strategy! Pay what you want for great games and help support TD Foundation!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 4th, 2027.

item.title: Hamble's Fright or Fight Halloween Bundle
item.content:encoded:
Spooky season calls for Humble’s Fright or Flight Halloween Bundle! Leave the lights on for Blair Witch, a story-driven psychological horror experience based on the cinematic lore of the iconic Blair Witch franchise. Explore the real world and spiritual realm as the protagonist of The Medium in a gripping, horror-filled exploration of your past traumas, or call your friends and gobble up DEVOUR, the 1 to 4-player horror survival game where you’ll stop cultists from carrying out their wicked plans. Enjoy frightening savings on the hottest horror games, and help support the WDC with your purchase.

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 4th, 2027.

item.title: Cozy After Dark Showcase Bundle
item.content:encoded:
Have some after hours fun with this bundle of cozy games set in the middle of the night! Follow a new vampire navigating a 19th century Eastern European town in Cabernet! Sneak into school at night and survive a botched séance in Fear the Spotlight! Help trapped souls in the afterlife and guide them toward closure in the emotional Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo! There’s even more atmospheric fun to be had in this bundle of cozy nighttime games, so grab them all now at the price of your choosing, and support Dames 4 Games with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 2nd, 2027.

item.title: Gals and Pals: PQube Japanese Games
item.description: Explore PQube’s gorgeous girls of gaming
item.content:encoded:
The content in this bundle is intended for mature audiences.

Fall into an intimate bundle of spicy Japanese games with the Gals and Pals Bundle published by PQube! Turn up the heat in Gal*Gun Returns, a colorfully reimagined version of the first game that started it all, the sensual sequel Gal*Gun 2, or the action-packed Gal*Gun: Double Peace! Massage your romantic impulses with these rail-shooters of beautiful bubbly girls, and fulfill your euphoric fantasies where bullets have been replaced with enchanting pheromone shots! Unwrap steamy gal-pal fun for a price you choose and help support Cool Effect with your purchase.

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 30th, 2027.

item.title: Twisted Trilogies and Terrors: Dark Visual Novels
item.description: Twisted trilogies and terrifying tales await.
item.content:encoded:
The content in this bundle is intended for mature audiences.

Sink your teeth into the Twisted Trilogies and Terrors: Dark Visual Novel Bundle, a seasonal collection of scary games! Choose from a trio of Spirit Hunter titles, including the critically acclaimed Death Mark II. Spooky supernatural studies are in session within the halls of Tokyo’s Konoehara Academy, and it’s your duty as a Spirit Doctor to cleanse the prestigious academy’s classrooms with your partner. Or try Class of '09, a trilogy of anti-visual novel games where you play as a beautiful heroine who causes chaos for every suitor who tries to gain your affection. Plus, your purchase helps support Movember!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 30th, 2027.

item.title: The Triple-i Initiative Showcase Bundle
item.description: A no-bloat showcase of player-first games!
item.content:encoded:
Buckle up for The Triple-i Initiative Showcase Bundle, an all-star collection of titles that celebrates the culture without extra fluff, hosts, or bloat. Unlock great games with exceptional value like X4: Foundations, The Last Spell - Complete Edition, My Time at Sandrock, and more! We’re proud to be a sponsor of the Triple-i Initiative Showcase. Catch up on their recent showcase to see what exciting new games will be highlighted this year! Plus, a portion of this purchase helps support Gamers Outreach!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 29th, 2027.

item.title: Beyond Reality: Sci-Fi & Survival VR Collection
item.content:encoded:
Blast off to faraway stars or stay home and hide from monsters in the woods with this bundle of sci-fi and horror (and sci-fi horror) VR games! Explore a derelict spaceship while fighting off an entity determined to mutate your own body in Star Trek: Infection! Command a fleet of ships through evolving stages of space battles in Homeworld: Vast Reaches! Run through the woods finding stick figures and hiding from a creature of terror and darkness in Blair Witch VR! Fully immerse yourself in outer space adventures and Earthbound terror with these VR games! Get them all now at the price of your choice and support HPV Cancers Alliance with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 28th, 2027.

item.title: Indie Fighters
item.content:encoded:
You’d better brush up on your combat skills if you want to take on these indie fighting games! Harness the power of the four elements to clobber your opponents to dust in Rivals of Aether II! Get a kick out of a modern fighting game with a retro arcade-inspired aesthetic in Pocket Bravery! Go back to basics and battle your enemies using just two buttons in the simple yet effective Divekick! Explore even more fighting game fun in this bundle of brawlers—you choose what you pay, and every purchase supports the rare disease research organization Raiden Science Foundation!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 28th, 2027.

item.title: Capcom Classics Bundle
item.content:encoded:
Return to the good old days with this bundle of classic Capcom games! If you saw the movie and caught Resident Evil fever, now you can play the first three games in the franchise and see how well you’d survive Raccoon City! And, from the same team that brought you all those gooey T-virus monsters, we’ve also included the first two Dino Crisis games, for those of you who wish Jurassic Park had more survival horror. And, for a modern spin on a classic, we also have 2026’s Breath of Fire IV, where a princess searches for her missing sister through two civilizations united by a precarious alliance. Experience the fun and adventure of classic Capcom at the price of your choosing, and support Breakthrough T1D with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 30th, 2027.

item.title: 2D Rewind Collection from S2 Games
item.content:encoded:
Transport yourself back to the good old days with this bundle of arcade-inspired fun! From pixelated beat-’em-ups to combat strategy games, this bundle has plenty of retro delights for the modern day. Hit the streets with the hot-blooded scrappers of River City Girls and River City Girls 2! Traverse the endless void in an evolving spaceship in Nova Drift! Play the slots and build your deck to make rent money in Luck Be a Landlord. Special thanks to S2 Games for making this collection possible! There’s even more 2D adventure to be had in this bundle, so grab these games now at the price of your choosing, and help support the Starlight Foundation with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 21st, 2027.

item.title: Programming Puzzles Bundle
item.content:encoded:
Stretch your brain muscles with this bundle of programming-themed puzzle games! Code and customize any gadgets you can build in Retro Gadgets! Design quantum algorithms by solving Zachlike puzzle games in Quantum Odyssey! Create a cat-to-human translator for your genius pet by solving machine learning-inspired neural network and decision tree puzzles in while True: learn()! Test your puzzling acumen and brush up on your programming skills with this bundle of games you can get right now for the price of your choice, and support Electronic Frontier Foundation with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 19th, 2027.

item.title: Bundle - Indie Fears
item.content:encoded:
Get into the spooky season with this new bundle of the creepiest indie games around! Discover what all the fuss is about with the much-memed space-set nightmare fuel game Mouthwashing. Keep a mystery train running and try not to run out of oxygen on the steep mountain slopes of Threshold. Flip burgers and keep your customers satisfied in the spooky cooking simulator send-up Kiosk. Those aren’t even the tip of the horror game iceberg featured in this bundle, so name your price and help support the Prevent Cancer Foundation charity with your purchase. And maybe keep a light on while you play. You never know.

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 14th, 2027.
